Image¶

In [1]:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

import astropy.io.fits as fits
from astropy.wcs import WCS

from astroplan import FixedTarget
from astroplan.plots import plot_finder_image
from astropy import units as u

Start with the object you picked for the Astro Coords Homewok.¶

  • Use FixedTarget and plot_finder_image to get the objects' FITS file.
  • Make sure to set the fov_radius = large enough to see all of the object (plus a little extra for context)
In [2]:
my_target = FixedTarget.from_name('Centaurus A')

fig, ax = plt.subplots(
    figsize = (6, 6), 
    constrained_layout = True
)

ax, hdu = plot_finder_image(
    my_target, 
    fov_radius= 0.4 * u.deg, 
    ax = ax,
    survey = 'DSS2 Blue'
);
In [ ]:

Get the World Coordinate System (WCS) data from your FITS file.¶

In [3]:
object_header = hdu.header
object_data   = hdu.data

my_wcs = WCS(object_header)

my_wcs

Create the following 4 plots:¶

  • Make them each a seperate plot (8 in x 8 in).
  • All images should have RA and DEC coords on the labels (use WCS)
  • Put a title on each plot
    • Plot 1: Your object
    • Plot 2: Your object where (values < MEAN set to min)
    • Plot 3: Your object where (values < (60% of MAX) set to min)
    • Plot 4: Your object where (values < (90% of MAX) set to min)

Actually change the values in the images. Don't just use vmin/vmax¶

In [4]:
fig, ax = plt.subplots(
    subplot_kw={'projection': my_wcs},
    figsize = (8, 8), 
    constrained_layout = True
)

ax.set_title("Centaurus A")
ax.set_xlabel("RA")
ax.set_ylabel("Dec")

ax.imshow(object_data, 
          cmap = plt.cm.twilight_shifted,
          origin = "lower");
In [5]:
copy_data = np.copy(object_data)

copy_data.min(), copy_data.mean(), copy_data.max()

copy_data[copy_data < copy_data.mean()] = copy_data.min()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(
    subplot_kw={'projection': my_wcs},
    figsize = (8, 8), 
    constrained_layout = True
)

ax.set_title("Centaurus A Values < Mean")
ax.set_xlabel("RA")
ax.set_ylabel("Dec")

ax.imshow(copy_data, 
          cmap = plt.cm.twilight_shifted,
          origin = "lower");
In [6]:
copy_data_2 = np.copy(object_data)

copy_data_2.min(), copy_data_2.mean(), copy_data_2.max()

copy_data_2[copy_data_2 < 0.6 * copy_data_2.max()] = copy_data_2.min()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(
    subplot_kw={'projection': my_wcs},
    figsize = (8, 8), 
    constrained_layout = True
)

ax.set_title("Centaurus A Values < 60% of Min")
ax.set_xlabel("RA")
ax.set_ylabel("Dec")

ax.imshow(copy_data_2, 
          cmap = plt.cm.twilight_shifted,
          origin = "lower");
